name: phase_01_identity_persistence
lock_risk: Creates empty Identity and registry tables and indexes; it does not rewrite or lock an existing product table.
representative_data: Runs from both the Phase 00 version-two snapshot and an empty database before deterministic synthetic identity seeds are loaded.
query_plan_review: The two tenant-leading indexes cover membership and session authority lookups; no data-reading or data-rewriting statement exists.
space_risk: Empty identity metadata tables, closed catalogues, and bounded supporting indexes only.
forward_fix: Add a new ordered migration for every correction after release; preserve version three and its checksum.
rollback: Before release only, remove the empty uncommitted schemas. After release, preserve state and apply a reviewed forward fix.
